scope: Planning within the README's historical analog-transfer lane only. No new explicit single-method lane paragraph is identifiable in this request. Do not select a lane or build a surface from these ranks.
ranking_basis: Qualitative expected usefulness for hidden-fault DTI, discounted for confounding and implementation cost. No numerical score forecasts; none is presently viable or promoted.

candidates.hypothesis: Cover-stratified, field-held-out transfer of magnetic/gravity edge-normal agreement
candidates.layers: Cached TMI, isostatic gravity, basement-depth and LiDAR step/coherence channels; independent field fault geometries from DOE GDR 1682 BRIDGE and/or GDR 207.
candidates.signature: Learn source-field fault versus lithologic-contact discrimination from normal agreement and cross-edge signed contrasts. Condition covariate-shift weighting on common basement-depth/relief support, not field identity.
candidates.missing_fault_rationale: Concealed discontinuities can affect density and susceptibility without a mapped scarp. Independent dense analog traces could teach that class; mere agreement does not establish a fault.
candidates.difference_from_repo: H33-F used the same regional catalogue inside named field masks, not independently mapped extra faults or field-held-out contact discrimination. H33-6 used fixed edge consensus and a baseline swap, not independent-label transfer. Do not rerun either failed arm.
candidates.expected_improvement: Highest conditional upside in this lane; unknown sign until independent-label confirmation
candidates.cost: Medium-high: GIS audit and independent source-label deduplication dominate; CPU model sufficient
candidates.availability: BLOCKED: official payload hosts are outside this session's outbound allowlist; no independent geometry bytes staged. Historical listing is not proof of current obtainability or licence.

candidates.hypothesis: Analog-transfer of structure-conditioned radiometric alteration residuals
candidates.layers: Owner-mirrored GeoDAWN K/Th/total-count channels, TMI and gravity ridges, basement depth; independent BRIDGE/GDR 207 field fault geometries.
candidates.signature: Within matched relief/depth/lithology strata, measure along-strike persistence of radiometric residuals across independently mapped source faults; transfer only inside common feature support.
candidates.missing_fault_rationale: Fluid alteration along permeable buried structures may preserve a weak geochemical halo even when no clear scarp is catalogued. Test against regional lithology, not hot-spring proximity alone.
candidates.difference_from_repo: Current radiometric cache contains scalar/transform channels; H33-F did not fit independent fault-conditioned residual distributions or a field-held-out radiometric negative control.
candidates.non_fault_mimic: Alluvial provenance or hydrothermal alteration unrelated to an active permeable fault
candidates.expected_improvement: Medium conditional upside, lower confidence than AT1 because surface transport can dominate
candidates.cost: Medium-high; source GIS plus stratum definition and negative controls
candidates.availability: BLOCKED: radiometric owner-mirror bytes available and pinned, official survey provenance not reauthenticated; independent field labels absent and official payload hosts unavailable here.

candidates.hypothesis: Field-held-out contrastive transfer of buried-fault cross-section motifs
candidates.layers: Cached det_elev curvature, basement depth, conductivity and gravity cross-edge profiles; independent BRIDGE/GDR 207 field picks.
candidates.signature: Compare oriented multi-layer profiles across source faults with matched unfaulted basin margins; align by local edge normal and transfer the shape, not absolute geographic coordinates.
candidates.missing_fault_rationale: Subtle flexural/structural contrasts can recur beneath cover without reproducing a regional mapped trace.
candidates.difference_from_repo: H33-F's per-pixel HGB and H33-6's local edge-normal product do not learn profile-shape contrastive motifs using independent field labels. This is not a new generic curvature transform claim.
candidates.non_fault_mimic: Shoreline terrace or erosional basin-margin flexure
candidates.expected_improvement: Medium-to-low conditional upside; profile alignment and source/target resolution mismatch increase risk
candidates.cost: High; profile extraction, support matching and independent field confirmation
candidates.availability: BLOCKED: local geophysical predictors available; official independent fault geometry payloads absent/unobtainable under host restriction.

candidates.hypothesis: Resolution-degraded analog motifs that survive removal of topographic evidence
candidates.layers: Cached magnetic/gravity/conductivity/basement fields and LiDAR step/coherence; independent source-field faults from BRIDGE/GDR 207.
candidates.signature: Train on independently mapped source faults at native support, then withhold LiDAR and degrade source features to target support. Retain only structures whose recovery remains stable under that prespecified ablation.
candidates.missing_fault_rationale: Tests whether a source motif depends on obvious exposed scarps or persists in subsurface measurements likely to detect covered faults.
candidates.difference_from_repo: No independent-label, field-held-out resolution-degradation experiment exists locally. It does not use the same catalogue twice or interpret discriminator AUC as a Ben-David bound.
candidates.non_fault_mimic: Regional processing seam that persists under smoothing
candidates.expected_improvement: Low direct upside; valuable falsification/robustness test rather than score-seeking ensemble
candidates.cost: High; requires AT1-quality source labels and instrument-resolution audit first
candidates.availability: BLOCKED: independent geometry unavailable; no viable method or submission proposed without it.
